messages.english: Record elevation benchmarks separately from the terrain model in your site survey.
messages.translation: Rikodani zwikombetshedzo zwa vhulapfu zwo fhambana na tsumbo ya mavu kha tsedzuluso ya fhethu hanu.

messages.english: Fetch a solar reference and record wind evidence with its height and source.
messages.translation: Dzhenisani tshiko tsha ḓuvha nahone rikodani vhutanzi ha muya na vhulapfu hawo na vhubvo.

messages.english: Your site → Site survey → Land & Location
messages.translation: Fhethu hanu → Tsedzuluso ya fhethu → Mavu na Vhudzulo

messages.english: Open your site survey to check the terrain reference and add a separately sourced elevation benchmark.
messages.translation: Vulani tsedzuluso ya fhethu hanu u tola tshiko tsha mavu nahone engedzani tshikombetshedzo tsha vhulapfu tshi no bva kha vhubvo ho fhambanaho.

messages.english: Your site → Site survey → Resources & Inputs
messages.translation: Fhethu hanu → Tsedzuluso ya fhethu → Zwishumiswa na Zwidzheniswa

messages.english: Review the reference solar assumptions and record wind height, source and period before saving.
messages.translation: Ṱolani mihumbulo ya tshiko tsha ḓuvha nahone rikodani vhulapfu ha muya, vhubvo na tshifhinga musi ni sa athu vhulunga.
